messages.subject: Converting IRT to CFA parameters in mirt
parts: Is there any way to convert IRT parameters to CFA parameters using mirt package?  If not, is there any package that performs this conversion?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Converting IRT to CFA parameters in mirt

Phil
